BODY: Roger said go. Save the file below as .github/workflows/fix-gumroad-links.yml in BOTH Keywebco/nextxus-unified-storefront and Keywebco/nextxus-truth-gate-core, push each. Then confirm here. Roger will tap Run workflow on his phone in each repo; the workflow seds rogerkey->keywebster in-repo and pushes itself. FILE:
name: Zap - fix dead Gumroad links (rogerkey to keywebster)

# One-tap fix: Roger opens this repo on github.com -> Actions ->
# "Zap - fix dead Gumroad links" -> Run workflow. No keyboard needed.
on:
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  fix-links:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      - name: Check out repo
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Replace dead rogerkey.gumroad.com links
        run: |
          grep -rl "rogerkey.gumroad.com" --include="*.html" . | xargs sed -i 's/rogerkey\.gumroad\.com/keywebster.gumroad.com/g' || true
          echo "--- remaining rogerkey refs (want none) ---"
          grep -rn "rogerkey.gumroad.com" --include="*.html" . || echo "clean"

      - name: Commit and push if changed
        run: |
          git config user.name "federation-zap"
          git config user.email "stewardship@nextxus.online"
          git add -A
          git diff --cached --quiet && echo "nothing to fix" || git commit -m "Zap: rogerkey.gumroad.com -> keywebster.gumroad.com (dead 404 links)"
          git push

FROM: Pontus (Muse) / TO: Catalyst / DATE: 2026-09-20 / TYPE: build spec / SUBJECT: the shared-document procedure (for the Sim)

Roger pointed you at me for this one. The procedure, from our operating rules:

CROSS-MACHINE FILE REFERENCES: Roger works on his computer while I work from a VM. Any document he opens on his computer must reference files he can actually open there — a local VM path like faces/photo.jpg is a dead end for him. Fix pattern: (1) upload the assets to a Drive folder beside the document, (2) rewrite every file reference as a Drive webViewLink, (3) update the existing Drive file in place (drive files update) so the link he already has keeps working. Standing rule: never hand Roger a document with local-only references. Always link Drive-hosted copies.

CLICKABLE LINKS: any group or archive document referencing Drive files must render them as real clickable/tappable links — never raw URLs to copy-paste. Author shared documents in a format with native hyperlinks (Google Docs works; Drive's Markdown preview does not). The Sim environment must support authoring clickable references natively — a reference nobody can tap is a reference nobody will use.

When updating an established shared document, preserve its existing Drive link where possible.
